changes: Fixed two defects: (1) a losing concurrent-DONE racer crashed with a raw StoryArtifactMissingError instead of a clean message, now translated when ctx.root no longer exists on disk; (2) field-regression-cli-smoke.ts exercised the deliberately-retired lattice-review-channel lane, now rejected and rerouted through lattice-review-test-coverage.
usage: Run lattice story_advance --phase=DONE twice concurrently on the same story from its own worktree; the loser now prints a clear explanatory message. Run node packages/main/dist/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.js to see the channel lane correctly rejected.
expectedOutcome: worktree-authority-smoke.js and field-regression-cli-smoke.js both print their success lines with zero errors; the two new RED scripts each correctly report their target defect is fixed.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/tasks/worktree-authority-smoke.js -> "worktree authority smoke passed"; node packages/main/dist/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.js -> "field regression CLI smoke passed"; both RED scripts exit non-zero with their own defect-still-present assertion failing (the expected GREEN signal).
limitations: Genuine cross-host quorum via codex exec was attempted but blocked by an external codex usage-limit exhaustion (resets 2026-08-20); DONE review-assurance-floor was satisfied via the documented degraded-single-host 3x1 fallback instead of a real 3x2 quorum.
pitfalls: A REVIEW finding (F-001) caught that an earlier revision of CHK-001 rerouted the transition lock root as a no-op fix -- acquireStoryTransitionLock already resolves through resolveSharedLockRoot internally, so the real fix is CHK-002 (the StoryArtifactMissingError translation) alone; a second finding (F-002) caught a stale comment describing that reverted mechanism, since fixed.
